name: CMS Momentum Sections - A Section Still In Draft

momentumSections.body: The donor recognition wall, promoted to the top of the page by an Order edit.

### Harvard in Tech is at an important turning point

We are a volunteer-led alumni community that has grown into a global network of founders, technologists, operators, investors, and professionals.
momentumSections.title: Why Support Harvard in Tech?

description: An ordered collection holding a drafted section. The draft sits in sequence with a Draft chip on its own row rather than being lifted into a separate group, because in a list that exists to show order, hoisting a row out of its place would misreport where the section actually sits on the page. The chip is required, not decorative: the group heading used to be the only thing saying an entry was a draft.
